criteria.FLOW_MSE: Maximize expected reduction of posterior variance of full-state maximum flow F(X).
criteria.SUMMARY_VOI: Maximize expected reduction of posterior variance of mean of20 monitored capacities. Finite-belief objective adaptation, not Gaussian/Kalman algorithm reproduction.

design.information: Same full prior, reliability, bounds, native reservation and H3 service eligibility supplied to all9 rules. New controls solved over all60460 batches to avoid heuristic-implementation confounding. Original7 selectors unchanged.
design.capacity_truth: Every one of2^20 full capacity states per graph, integer FIFO push-relabel, primal capacity/conservation/mincut equality checked for every state. Full-state values only define estimation objectives; allocation J still uses conservative revealed-capacity maxflow.
